Proposal title: Open protocols unite: Common goals in advocating?
Abstract: Can open protocols communities learn from each other? For sure! I would like to talk about political demands from a perspective of advocating for open protocols based social networks in EUrope. And why I build the alliance “Open networks and public spheres”.  I would like to learn about your political demands as the Matrix community and what common struggles are that ActivityPub or atproto communities share with you?
